admissions_overview.summary: In Malta you apply directly to each institution. Most University of Malta degrees need the Matriculation Certificate (two Advanced and three Intermediate subjects plus Systems of Knowledge, taken after two years of sixth form) together with SEC passes in Maltese, English Language and Mathematics, and many courses name extra subjects. MCAST and ITS courses accept SEC results directly, with the number and grade of passes depending on the level of the course.
admissions_overview.notes: Entry requirements and course lists change from year to year. Always check the course page of the institution before you apply. Only a sample of courses is listed for each faculty or institute.
